hrsa_health_centers.geography: point coordinates; all in-scope U.S. sites retained for border-aware nearest-site search

method.distance: great-circle (haversine), kilometers; Gazetteer internal points to active HRSA site coordinates
method.missingness: no imputation; missing raw indicator stays null; affected score/composite stays null

composite.health_need: mean of within-study-area midrank percentiles for diabetes, high blood pressure, and depression crude prevalence
composite.social_disadvantage: mean of within-study-area midrank percentiles for poverty rate, no-vehicle household rate, and reversed median household income
composite.healthcare_access_barrier: within-study-area midrank percentile of straight-line nearest-HRSA-site distance in km
composite.normalization: empirical average ranks scaled 0-100 within Lucas County; ties receive average rank; higher means larger burden/barrier
composite.weighting: equal across three domains; equal within health and social domains
composite.missing_rule: no imputation; each domain requires all of its component indicators; composite requires all three domain scores
composite.interpretation: Exploratory descriptive index; not clinically validated, causal, or a definitive area ranking. Percentiles depend on the small study-area set.
